import os,stat,json,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects')
H=root/'hopper'
U=Path('/home/ubuntu/.local/share/rea-optional-uv-0.13.6')
A=Path('/home/ubuntu/.local/share/apktool')
C=root/'codex-agent'
T=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
F=Path('/home/ubuntu/.local/share/motor-ferrari')
report={'scope':'only proven orphan Android/REA/Hopper remnants and obsolete project aliases','status':'ABORTED','Ferrari_alias_untouched':True}
def need(x,msg):
 if not x:raise RuntimeError(msg)
def active(n):return subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','is-active','--quiet',n],timeout=9).returncode==0
def free():x=os.statvfs('/srv/projects');return x.f_bavail*x.f_frsize
try:
 need(os.geteuid()==0,'need root')
 need(H.is_dir() and not H.is_symlink() and set(p.name for p in H.iterdir())=={'bin','lib'},'Hopper installation fingerprint differs')
 need((H/'bin/Hopper').is_file() and (H/'bin/hopper_mcp').is_file(),'Hopper binaries not recognized')
 need(U.is_dir() and not U.is_symlink() and all(n.name in {'bin','lib','lib64','include','pyvenv.cfg','share'} for n in U.iterdir()),'REA optional old Python environment not recognized')
 need(A.is_dir() and not A.is_symlink(),'legacy global Apktool path differs')
 need(set(p.name for p in A.iterdir())=={'framework'},'legacy Apktool has extra files')
 fr=A/'framework'
 need(fr.is_dir() and not fr.is_symlink() and all(p.is_symlink() and p.name=='1.apk' for p in fr.iterdir()),'legacy Apktool framework changed')
 need(C.is_symlink() and os.readlink(C)=='/srv/projects/Codex','Codex alias changed')
 need(T.is_symlink() and os.readlink(T)=='/srv/projects/telegram-robot-leads','Telegram alias changed')
 need(F.is_symlink() and os.readlink(F)=='/srv/projects/skill-universal','Ferrari transport alias must be preserved')
 units=['ssh','nginx','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads','postgresql@16-main']
 svc={s:active(s) for s in units}
 need(all(svc.values()),'critical service inactive before cleanup')
 for name in ('pm2-telegram-robot-leads','pm2-iptvpn-bot','fadego-staging','pink-iptv-backend'):
  x=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','show',name+'.service','--property=ExecStart,WorkingDirectory'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=9)
  need('/opt/telegram-robot-leads' not in x.stdout and '/srv/projects/codex-agent' not in x.stdout,'service relies on old aliases')
 ancestor=set();me=os.getpid()
 while me>1 and me not in ancestor:
  ancestor.add(me)
  try:
   raw=(Path('/proc')/str(me)/'stat').read_text()
   me=int(raw.split(') ')[1].split()[1])
  except Exception:break
 for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
  if not p.name.isdecimal() or int(p.name) in ancestor:continue
  try:
   cwd=os.readlink(p/'cwd')
   need(not any(cwd.startswith(str(v)) for v in (H,U,A)),'live process working in old vendor')
   raw=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes()
   need(b'/opt/telegram-robot-leads' not in raw and b'/srv/projects/codex-agent' not in raw,'process command uses old alias')
   for f in (p/'fd').iterdir():
    try:q=os.readlink(f)
    except OSError:continue
    need(not any(q.startswith(str(v)) for v in (H,U,A)),'process has old vendor file open')
  except (FileNotFoundError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError):pass
 for line in Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines():
  x=line.split()
  if len(x)>4:need(not any(x[4].startswith(str(v)) for v in (H,U,A)),'filesystem mounted on orphan vendor')
 free0=free()
 shutil.rmtree(H)
 shutil.rmtree(U)
 shutil.rmtree(A)
 C.unlink()
 T.unlink()
 need(not H.exists() and not U.exists() and not A.exists() and not C.is_symlink() and not T.is_symlink(),'residual orphan path remains')
 need(F.is_symlink() and F.resolve()==root/'skill-universal','Ferrari bridge alias lost')
 after={s:active(s) for s in units}
 need(after==svc,'service status changed after orphan cleanup')
 report.update(status='PASS',removed_paths=['/srv/projects/hopper','/home/ubuntu/.local/share/rea-optional-uv-0.13.6','/home/ubuntu/.local/share/apktool','/srv/projects/codex-agent','/opt/telegram-robot-leads'],freed_bytes=free()-free0,free_bytes=free(),critical_service_states_unchanged=True,project_data_untouched=True)
except Exception as e:report['error']=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:260]
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True))
